item.title: Stem cells identified as driver of age-related belly fat
item.description:
Aging may trigger specialized stem cells that increase the body's ability to create belly fat. This discovery identifies a potential biological driver of middle-age weight gain and a target for future anti-obesity treatments.

item.title: Factors Behind Building Damage in Venezuela's Second Earthquake
item.description:

item.title: Screen time linked to developmental risks in children under two
item.description:
A landmark study suggests that screen time for babies and toddlers can lead to long-term negative health effects. Researchers are calling for urgent investigation into the risks posed by digital devices to infants.
